summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. Changes: rdflib/namespace.py adds Namespace.__contains__ (prefix test: ref.startswith(str(self))), ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (any(ref == uri) over stored term URIs, node-type-aware, inherited by _RDFNamespace), and fixed _ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri). test/test_namespace.py adds NamespaceMembershipTest covering prefix positive/proper-prefix/self cases, RDFS positive/undefined/plain-string/Literal negatives, and RDF.type positive. Tests and doctests were not run per instructions. No commits made. No container-property (_1) test was added.
